o1: Enables netrin receptor binding activity and non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine kinase activity. Predicted to enable tyrosine kinase activity and protein tyrosine kinase activity. Involved in axis specification; commissural neuron axon guidance; embryonic morphogenesis; establishment of spindle orientation; asymmetric cell division; and mitotic spindle orientation. Located in contractile muscle fiber and phagocytic cup. Is expressed in anchor cell; anus; distal tip cell; head neurons; and vulval cell. Is part of the MES-1/SRC-1 signaling pathway. Predicted to interact with MES-1. Used to study Goldenhar syndrome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in colorectal cancer (multiple); diabetes mellitus (multiple); ductal carcinoma in situ; immunodeficiency 22; and systemic lupus erythematosus. Orthologous to FYN (FYN proto-oncogene, Src family tyrosine kinase); SRC (SRC proto-oncogene, non-receptor tyrosine kinase); and YES1 (YES proto-oncogene 1, Src family tyrosine kinase).
